sentences.en: An exhibition was given in anticipation of the Queen's visit.
sentences.zh: 为了女王来访，举办了一场展览。

sentences.en: Half the pain of chest waxing is in the anticipation.
sentences.zh: 胸部脱毛一半的痛苦在于期待。

sentences.en: Mother took the clothes off the line in anticipation of rain.
sentences.zh: 妈妈见要下雨就把晾的衣服收起来了。

senses.zh: 期待，希望,预期，预测，预感,<律>（信托财产收益的）预支
